lsn_orch_001.trigger_condition: Malformed JSON or truncated keys in scene_plan.json
lsn_orch_001.repair_recipe: Rebuild baseline scene_plan.json structure using ensure_motion_planning_artifacts()
lsn_orch_001.rationale: Automated rebuild of baseline scene_plan resolves syntax errors without rerunning transcription.

lsn_orch_002.trigger_condition: Stale temporary .tmp or .lock files from interrupted run
lsn_orch_002.repair_recipe: Unlink stale *.tmp and *.lock files in project root directory
lsn_orch_002.rationale: Cleaning orphan lock files resolves contention without process restart.

lsn_orch_003.trigger_condition: Remotion headless rendering timeout under heavy CPU load
lsn_orch_003.repair_recipe: Boost timeout deadline to 180s and retry with single concurrency thread
lsn_orch_003.rationale: Rendering high-density kinetic typography on Windows CPU benefits from extended timeout budget.

lsn_orch_004.trigger_condition: Attempting automatic progression past Stage 8 without human approval sign-off
lsn_orch_004.repair_recipe: Never retry automatic progression on unapproved timeline; halt and await human PIN sign-off
lsn_orch_004.rationale: Mandatory human approval gate cannot be bypassed by automated retry.
